test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Amit is sitting second to the left of Jia. Jia is an immediate neighbour of both Varun and Pramod. Sia is sitting second to the left of Amit. Amit is an immediate neighbour of both Mahesh and Varun. Who is the immediate neighbour of Sia and Jia?
solution:
**Given: **Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Amit is sitting second to the left of Jia.

2) Sia is sitting second to the left of Amit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2271bff0668102efd65dbd56c7ad45b117046b6af9c679fc8de9d91a26072e72.png] 

3) Jia is an immediate Neighbour of both Varun and Pramod.

4) Amit is an immediate Neighbour of both Mahesh and Varun.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c0f774f5b19db7d95d3698f17f4db33dea61a5593a5a6462c53fc8c08ddddd6.png] 

Thus,** Pramod **is the immediate Neighbour of Sia and Jia.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
